## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`

## Checklist

- [ ] User-facing text and documentation are in English
- [ ] Tests cover new or changed behavior
- [ ] No secrets, generated `dist/` files, or local `.openspec-viewer/` notes are included
- [ ] Documentation and changelog entries are updated when relevant
